entity: Traffic Department of the City of Los Angeles
stance_basis: described as having ongoing programs for traffic signal modernization and control improvements, no position on the transit project expressed
summary: The Traffic Department of the City of Los Angeles is described in the document as having an ongoing program to modernize and interconnect traffic signals citywide, investigating peak-hour parking restrictions and turn controls, and planning a computer-based traffic surveillance and control system for the Los Angeles CBD. The agency is referenced as a source of traffic data and as a participant in existing traffic management efforts, but expresses no explicit position on the proposed transit alternatives.
complaint_summary: The Traffic Department of the City of Los Angeles is described as running an ongoing program to modernize and interconnect nearly all traffic signals in the city, investigating peak-hour parking restrictions and turn controls, and planning a computer-based traffic surveillance and control system for the Los Angeles CBD.
